title: ARSIA Audit Query Response
description: Cursor-paginated response from the audit trail query endpoint (GET /.well-known/arsia/audit). Contains ArsiaAuditRecord objects ordered by processed_at ascending with pagination metadata. Defined in ARSIA-State.md §7.4. Requires arsiaprotocol.audit.read capability. The endpoint supports 10 query parameters: from_agent, to_agent, after (RFC 3339), before (RFC 3339), event_type, compliance_profile, human_oversight_status, payment_reference, limit (integer, default 100, max 1000), after_record_id (cursor-based pagination).

AuditRecord.description: Immutable audit record for a compliance-relevant event. Defined in ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

allOf.description: Unique identifier for this audit record (UUID v4). Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.
The id field of the ARSIA message that this record documents (UUID v4). Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

event_type.description: The type of event being audited. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

from_agent.description: The agent-id of the message sender. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

to_agent.description: The agent-id of the message recipient. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

intent.description: The intent field from the originating message (ARSIA-Core.md §4.1). Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

payload_type.description: The payload.type field from the originating message. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

allOf.description: SHA-256 hash (lowercase hex) of the payload from the originating message. When security.encrypted is false or absent: SHA-256(RFC8785(payload)). When security.encrypted is true: SHA-256(UTF-8(JWE string)). Verifiable without decryption keys. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1 and ARSIA-Core.md §5.3.1.

SHA-256 hash (lowercase hex) of the RFC 8785 canonicalized plaintext payload. Present ONLY when the originating message has security.encrypted=true. Enables dispute resolution over encrypted content. MUST NOT be present when security.encrypted is false or absent. See ARSIA-Core.md §5.3.1.

compliance_profile.description: The compliance profile name from the message's compliance.profile field, or 'none'. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

human_oversight_status.description: Status of human oversight for this event. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

approver_id.description: The agent-id of the agent that issued the approval_decision. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

allOf.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with millisecond precision (UTC). Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.
Date until which this record MUST be retained. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.
ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for audit record storage location. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

operator_id.description: The owner_id from the IdentityRecord of the agent that owns this audit log. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.1.

allOf.description: SHA-256 of previous record's record_id concatenated with payload_hash. Tamper detection. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.2.

sub_type.description: Escrow sub-type. Present when event_type is 'asset_transfer'. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.

payment_reference.description: Payment reference from the originating AssetTransferRequest. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.

amount.description: The escrowed or transferred amount. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.1.

currency_or_unit.description: Currency code or unit identifier. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.1.

release_agent.description: Agent-id of the authorised escrow release agent. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.1.

released_by.description: Agent-id of the agent that triggered escrow release. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.2.

release_trigger.description: The payload.type of the release message. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.2.

allOf.description: UUID v4 referencing the escrow creation record. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.2–§4.3.4.
Actual time the escrow timeout was processed. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.3.

disputed_by.description: Agent-id of the party that raised the dispute. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.4.

dispute_reason.description: Human-readable reason for the escrow dispute. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.4.

arbitration_agent.description: Agent-id of the arbitration agent. Per ARSIA-Assets.md §4.3.4.

risk_level.description: Risk level from the ActionDescriptor. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §3.5 Record 1.

allOf.description: UUID v4 linking oversight audit records to the originating request. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §3.5.
Approval deadline timestamp from the pending_approval message. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §3.5 Record 2.

reason.description: Reason field. Present when event_type is 'approval_decision' (ARSIA-Actions.md §3.5 Record 3) or 'state_purge' (ARSIA-State.md §3.2.2).

key.description: State entry key. Present in state_set, state_delete, and state_purge audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.1.2, §3.1.3, §3.2.2.

owner_agent_id.description: Agent-id of the state entry owner. Present in state_set, state_delete, and state_purge audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.1.2, §3.1.3, §3.2.2.

actor_agent_id.description: Agent-id of the agent that performed the operation. May differ from owner_agent_id when operating via a grant. Present in state_set and state_delete audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.1.2, §3.1.3.

initiator_agent_id.description: Agent-id of the agent that initiated the purge operation. Present in state_purge audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.2.2.

version.description: State entry version after the operation. Present in state_set and state_delete audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.1.2, §3.1.3.

pii_classification.description: GDPR classification of the state entry data. Present in state_set and state_purge audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.1.2, §3.2.2.

legal_basis.description: GDPR Art. 6(1) legal basis from the message's compliance.legal_basis field. Present in state_set audit records when pii_classification is 'personal'. Not stored on the StateEntry — recorded only in the audit event for GDPR Art. 6(1) traceability. Per ARSIA-State.md §8.3 Rule 3.

allOf.description: Event time — when the operation occurred at the origin. Distinct from processed_at (ingestion time). Present in state_set, state_delete, state_grant, and state_revoke audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.1.2, §3.1.3, §3.3.1, §3.3.2.

Timestamp of actual data destruction. Distinct from processed_at (ingestion time) and timestamp (event time). Has autonomous legal significance for GDPR Art. 5(2) accountability. Present in state_purge audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.2.2.
UUID identifier of the access grant. Present in state_grant and state_revoke audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.3.1, §3.3.2.

key_pattern.description: Key or key prefix pattern for the grant. Present in state_grant audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.3.1.

grantor_agent_id.description: Agent-id of the agent granting access. Present in state_grant and state_revoke audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.3.1, §3.3.2.

grantee_agent_id.description: Agent-id of the agent receiving access. Present in state_grant and state_revoke audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.3.1, §3.3.2.

access_level.description: Access level of the grant. Present in state_grant audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.3.1.

valid_until.description: Grant expiry timestamp or null for no expiry. Present in state_grant audit records. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.3.1.

records.description: Array of ArsiaAuditRecord objects ordered by processed_at ascending. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.4.

total.description: Total number of records matching the query filters regardless of limit. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.4.

has_more.description: Whether additional records exist beyond the current page. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.4.

allOf.description: The record_id (UUID v4) of the last record in the current page. Pass as after_record_id in the next request for cursor-based pagination. Present when has_more is true. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.4.
